scenes.headline: How an agent rebuilds a room from an iPhone scan
scenes.sub: A LiDAR capture app, a modeling skill, and a three.js viewer
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Sill! This project turns a phone scan of a room into a scene made of code.

scenes.text: The scan says where things are and how big. The photos say what they look like. The agent writes code, then checks it from each photo's own camera.
scenes.say: The scan gives measurements, the photos give looks, and the agent checks its work from where each photo was taken.

scenes.title: What the phone records
scenes.say: The phone app records four things.

items.say: Apple's room scanner gives walls, doors, windows and furniture boxes.
The depth sensor builds a mesh of every surface.
Photos, each with its exact position and lens.
And small depth images, several a second.

scenes.title: Which photos the app takes
scenes.text: q = min(1, pixels per cm / 4) x sharp x depth
scenes.say: The app picks its own photos, scoring every mesh point by how well it's been seen.

parts.note: closer and more head-on is better
parts.say: Pixels per centimetre: near and square on wins, up to about four.

parts.note: predicted blur, from the phone's motion
parts.say: Times sharpness, predicted from the phone's motion.

parts.note: zero if something is in front
parts.say: Times an occlusion check. It shoots where the score rises most.

steps.say: Take a photo, and put a three.js camera at its exact pose.
A script pastes the photo beside the render. It does not score them.
The agent looks, names the biggest difference, and fixes the code.
Then renders again. When to stop is a judgement call.

scenes.credit: our render of the repo's office demo
scenes.title: Everything here is code

steps.say: This is the shipped office, rendered on my machine. None of it is a scanned mesh.
The desk, monitors and chair are code the agent wrote, sized from the scan.

scenes.label: triangles in the shipped office, from code the agent wrote

scenes.text: Good capture makes the loop closable: every surface gets a close, sharp photo at a known pose, so the agent can compare.
scenes.say: The clever part is the capture: every surface gets a sharp photo at a known pose, so a simple loop can work.
Scan for size, photos for looks, and check from the photo's own camera.
